name: Breaker operation-count feedback
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
summary: Identifies a feedback event representing a completed defined mechanical operation.
description: Identifies a feedback event representing a completed defined mechanical operation. Breaker status indications describe the operating mechanism, the removable truck or the health of a supporting system. These signals are related but are not interchangeable: an open breaker can still have its truck connected to live bus contacts.

In a switchgear control schematic, the bay controller compares independent status contacts before displaying a position or allowing another operation. The signal labels explain which physical state each contact represents. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Operation feedback event” at the input and “Maintenance counter input” at the output. The counted operation must be specified.

Keep contact reference conditions, terminal numbers and interpretation logic together. Distinguish a mechanically operated indication from a measured current or voltage condition. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application.
